walkthroughs.body_html:
Innovation & Design — a core area of Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Innovation & Design brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Innovation & Design.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Whose 2005 Double Diamond models the design process?

UK Design Council
Stanford d.school
Frog Design

options: SCAMPER
TRIZ
PMI
SWOT

mcqs.q: What does an LDR's resistance do as light intensity INCREASES?
options: The black colour absorbing energy.
It increases (more light = more resistance).
It stays constant.
It decreases.

mcqs.q: What gives carbon fibre composite its strength?
options: The carbon fibres alone - the resin is just glue.
The fibres provide tensile strength; the resin matrix holds them in place and transfers loads.
It stays constant.
The black colour absorbing energy.

mcqs.q: What force does a rope in a tug-of-war experience?
options: Compression - because it is squeezed by hands.
Shear.
It stays constant.
Tension - it is being pulled at both ends.
